scope_by_subfield.psychology-behavior: Empirical personality and social psychology, including meta-analyses and replications. Existing-data work must advance knowledge of social behavior and meet transparency rules for data, code, materials and codebooks; generic literature summaries are insufficient. Sage requires disclosure of generative AI and prohibits specified uses, including producing a submission through successive prompts and analysing experiences/themes; ordinary assistive editing has a disclosure exemption. Source: https://www.sagepub.com/journals/publication-ethics-policies/artificial-intelligence-policy. The review tag covers empirical synthesis such as meta-analysis; the ordinary listed article types are empirical research and replication studies.

venues.scope_notes: Applied public health and health promotion research, reviews and short reports. Secondary-data research and review methods can fit. Original research and reviews are subject to peer review; Current Topics and Opinions, In Practice and Features are editorial categories rather than equivalent peer-reviewed research.

route.conditions: Standard subscription route has no submission or publication fees. Online colour is free; requested print colour and optional OA cost extra. Original research/reviews normally require 2000–4000 words including abstracts, excluding references/tables/figures; no paid excess-length option is stated. A plain-language summary is required for article types needing an abstract. Optional professional author services are not required.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None for standard publication without optional print colour or OA; no compulsory society membership stated.

ai_policy.summary: Human-led literature assistance and generated or checked research code are expressly listed as appropriate subject to disclosure. Conditional partial substantive drafting is inferred from the treatment of primary or partial generated text, the statement that disclosed use alone is not grounds for rejection, and the non-exhaustive examples; the policy does not expressly list drafting as an appropriate example. Authors remain responsible for accuracy and original sources.

disclosure.instructions: Disclose generated content that directly affects methodology, analysis, results or conclusions upon submission for editorial evaluation; appropriate research uses are disclosed in methods or acknowledgements. Suggestions to improve the author’s language, grammar or structure need no disclosure. Verify outputs and original sources.
